review: Four candidate sets, eight poses, four built-in calls, no corrections required at initial visual inspection. Standing calf raise pairs show full soles grounded then raised heels with forefoot/toe floor contact, near-straight legs and body/bar rising along guides; bar across upper shoulders and closed grips. Detailed exposed grayscale anatomy and full opaque shirt/shorts retained. Qualified shrug/elbow constancy, grip, bilateral heel clearance, ankle range, bar placement and muscle localization remain pending. All original masters and exact prompts saved.
